title: Raising Responsible Kids - Chores from Age 1
description:
🎙️ COMING SOON — Episode 7 of the Working Moms Podcast

We’re honored to welcome Mrs. Mary Sue Watson — Child Development Expert, Child Care Owner, educator, entrepreneur, and my incredible mother-in-law — who brings over 60 years of unmatched wisdom in early childhood development and parenting.

In this must-hear episode, we dive into powerful parenting strategies, including:

✅ Yes, even at age ONE! — How to start teaching responsibility with simple, hands-on household tasks
✅ Why sleep (for both kids and moms) isn’t optional — it’s essential
✅ The hidden costs of burnout and how to avoid it before it’s too late
✅ What every parent should ask when touring a daycare
✅ How to drop the guilt and embrace the working mom journey with confidence

This conversation is packed with real-life experience, heartfelt encouragement, and actionable advice every modern mom can use.

📌 Episode 7 drops soon — you don’t want to miss this one!
